main_text.p: שָׁקַר Ch. Mendax. Plur. שְׁקָרִין Mendaces, Jesa.26.10.

שרא שְׁרִי, שְׁרָה Ch. & Syr. Solvit, dissolvit: absol-vit: dimisit aliquem: valedicere alicui, Syr. 2.ad Corinth. 2.13. Marc.6.46. Item Sedit, habitavit, mansit, remansit, commoratus, diversatus est, divertit, castrametatus est, castra posuit: Hinc & Syr. in Ethpah. Epulari, prandere, ut Joh.21.12.&c. Item Coepit, incepit, inchoavit. Pah. שָׁרֵי Idem: Item Ch. Habitare fecit, inhabitandum dedit, Psal. 74.2. Ithpahel אִשְׁתָּרִי Solvi, dissolvi, dimitti, remitti, absolvi: Syr. Diverti, diversari, habitare, commorari: epulari, convivari: discedere, Act.28.25. Aphel אַשְׁרִי Habitare, manere, commorari, recumbere fecit, Gen.24.11.
שְׁרֵי Ch. Solutus, liber, licitus, concessus. Foemin. שְׁרֵיא Dies liber est, sc. ad emendum, Esth.3.8. in Targum sec. Idem quod Rab. מותר. Oppositum ejus אסירא.
שְׁרוּיָא, שְׁרוּי Chald. Syr. Initium, Principium, Exordium.
שְׁרִיוּתָא, שְׁרוּתָא & שְׁרוּת, שְׁרוּי Ch. Syr. Convivium, sympolium, prandium: cibus, victus. Plur. שִׁירִין Convivia, Hosea 4.18.
Syr. Compages, commissurae, ad Heb. 4.12. ad Eph.4.16.

page.notes: Syriac and Hebrew characters are rendered approximately; the Syriac vowel-pointed words in the original could not be reliably read letter by letter and some Syriac forms are unclear.
